sections.Profile:
Cosmic Pinball, produced by Briarwood—a division of Brunswick Manufacturing Company—in 1977, is a home model pinball machine with a space theme. Designed for single-player enjoyment, it features two flippers and two pop bumpers, providing straightforward gameplay suitable for home entertainment.
